title: Content Creator
company: Greenfield I T Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
Content Creator - Social & Video
York
Hybrid (2 days per week in the office)
£30,000 - £35,000 per annum plus company benefits

Are you passionate about social media, video production and digital storytelling? We're recruiting on behalf of our client for a creative Content Creator to join their marketing team and help produce engaging content across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and other digital channels.

The Role:
- Create engaging short-form video content for social media.
- Take content from concept to filming, editing and final delivery.
- Produce social graphics, digital assets and campaign content.
- Film, edit and repurpose video content across multiple platforms.
- Support wider marketing campaigns with creative content.
- Monitor trends and develop fresh content ideas that drive engagement.
- Assist with longer-form video projects, interviews and promotional content.

The Candidate:
- 1-3 years' experience in content creation, social media, video production or a similar role.
- Strong portfolio showcasing video and social content.
- Skilled in Canva, CapCut and Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Premiere Pro, Photoshop and Illustrator.
- Strong filming, editing and storytelling abilities.
- Good understanding of social media trends and platform-specific content.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects.
- Creative, proactive and confident working independently or as part of a team.
- Comfortable appearing on camera when required.

For further information please contact Paige Bevan on or email

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive
Location: Knaresborough
Salary: £26,000 - £30,000 per annum
Hours: Monday - Friday, Full-time

Want to create marketing that actually means something?

We're working with an established organisation that is looking for a Marketing Executive to join their team and play an important part in how they communicate with their audiences.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who loves marketing, enjoys creating great content and wants their work to have a genuine purpose.

You'll be involved in a broad mix of marketing activity from social media, email campaigns and website content through to creative design, events, communications and campaign reporting. You'll have the opportunity to bring your own ideas to the table, whilst working closely with an experienced Marketing Manager and wider team.

Whether you already have some marketing experience or you're a recent Marketing graduate looking for your first career opportunity, we're interested in hearing from you.

What will you be doing as Marketing Executive?
- Creating engaging content for digital, social media, email and other marketing channels
- Supporting the planning and delivery of marketing campaigns
- Writing and editing content, ensuring everything is accurate, engaging and on brand
- Managing and updating website content
- Helping to grow and maintain social media channels
- Supporting email marketing activity and monitoring campaign performance
- Creating marketing materials and digital assets using design tools such as Canva and Adobe
- Supporting promotional activity around events, including attending events when required
- Assisting with PR, communications and media activity
- Using marketing data and analytics to understand what is working and identify opportunities to improve
- Helping maintain brand consistency across all marketing communications
- Working with colleagues, external contacts and creative partners on marketing projects
- Bringing new ideas, creativity and energy to the wider marketing function

What are we looking for?
Our client is open minded about experience. You might already be working as a Marketing Executive, Marketing Assistant, Digital Marketing Executive, Content Executive or Communications Assistant, or you could be a recent graduate ready to take your first step into a marketing career.

What matters most is that you're creative, enthusiastic and genuinely passionate about producing marketing that connects with people and supports something worthwhile.
You'll ideally have:
- A genuine interest in marketing, content and communications
- Strong written communication skills and an excellent eye for detail
- Confidence creating content for social media and digital channels
- An interest in design, branding and visual content
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities
- A willingness to learn new systems, platforms and ways of working
- A positive, proactive and collaborative approach
- The confidence to contribute ideas rather than simply wait to be told what to do

What's on offer?
- £26,000 - £30,000 per annum
- A genuinely varied marketing position
- The opportunity to work across content, digital, social media, campaigns, events and communications
- Plenty of scope to develop your marketing skills and broaden your experience
- The opportunity to see your ideas turned into real campaigns and communications
- A supportive team environment where creativity and initiative are encouraged
- The chance to work for an organisation where the work you produce has a positive impact on people

Ready to make your mark?
If you're looking for a marketing role where you can be creative, develop your skills and know that what you're producing has a real purpose, this could be a brilliant next step.
We're particularly keen to hear from people who are passionate about what they do, full of ideas and want to use their marketing skills to create something positive.

Apply now or contact Impression Recruitment for a confidential conversation about the opportunity.

Our Guarantee
Thank you for your initial expression of interest in our available vacancy. If we have not contacted you within 5 working days of your application, please understand that the CV received, and the information provided does not meet the requirements of the current vacancy. However, we will consider all applications for any available opportunity, present or future, and proactively contact you should we deem there to be a suitable match.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager
Location: Knaresborough
Salary: £35,000 - £40,000 per annum
Hours: Monday - Friday, Full-time - Part time hours also considered

Ready to take ownership of a marketing function?

We're working with an established organisation that is looking for an experienced and commercially minded Marketing Manager to take the lead on its marketing and communications activity.

This is an opportunity to step into a role where your ideas, strategy and expertise will genuinely make a difference. You'll have ownership of the marketing plan, helping to shape how the organisation communicates with its audiences, builds engagement and continues to grow.

You'll work closely with senior colleagues and manage a varied programme of activity spanning digital marketing, content, social media, campaigns, PR, brand, website, advertising and events. You'll also have responsibility for guiding a Marketing Executive and coordinating external agencies and creative partners.

The organisation is looking for someone who is passionate about what they do and motivated by the opportunity to create marketing that has a positive impact on people.

What will you be responsible for as Marketing Manager?
- Developing and delivering an integrated marketing strategy aligned with wider organisational objectives
- Planning and managing campaigns across digital and offline channels
- Taking ownership of brand messaging, content and communications
- Developing engaging content across social media, email, website and publications
- Leading social media strategy and using performance data to continually improve results
- Managing digital advertising activity, including paid social and search
- Overseeing website content, SEO and conversion activity
- Planning marketing campaigns around events and wider initiatives
- Developing PR activity and building relationships with relevant external contacts
- Using analytics and campaign data to measure performance and shape future activity
- Managing the marketing budget and ensuring activity delivers value
- Working with external agencies, designers and other creative partners
- Managing and supporting a Marketing Executive, providing direction and developing their skills
- Identifying new ideas, opportunities and better ways of working across the marketing function
- Ensuring everything produced is consistent, engaging and aligned with the organisation's brand

What are we looking for?
You could currently be working as a Marketing Manager, Marketing & Communications Manager, Digital Marketing Manager, Senior Marketing Executive or Marketing Lead and be ready for a role where you can take greater ownership.

Our client is looking for someone who can combine strategic thinking with a practical marketing ability. You'll be confident developing a plan, but equally happy getting involved in the detail and making things happen.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in a broad marketing role, ideally with responsibility for strategy and campaign delivery
- Strong digital marketing and content experience
- Excellent written communication and copywriting skills
- Experience managing social media and digital campaigns
- Good understanding of website, SEO, email and marketing analytics
- Experience using data and insight to evaluate and improve marketing activity
- Strong organisational and project management skills
- Experience managing agencies, freelancers or other external partners
- Ideally, some experience of managing or mentoring a junior marketing colleague
- A creative mindset with an excellent eye for detail
- The confidence to challenge, contribute ideas and influence stakeholders
- A proactive and positive approach, with a genuine interest in what the organisation does

What's on offer?
- £35,000 - £40,000 per annum
- A broad and influential marketing position
- Genuine ownership of the marketing strategy and activity
- The opportunity to shape and develop the organisation's marketing approach
- Variety across digital, content, campaigns, PR, brand, website and events
- Responsibility for managing a Marketing Executive
- The opportunity to work with external agencies and creative partners
- A role where creativity and new ideas are actively encouraged
- The chance to use your marketing expertise for something that has a genuine positive impact on people

Want your marketing to make a difference?
If you're an experienced marketer looking for a role where you can take ownership, shape strategy and see the impact of your work, this could be an excellent next move.

This is more than simply managing campaigns. It's an opportunity to become a key part of an organisation, bring fresh thinking to its marketing and help communicate something that genuinely matters.

Apply now or contact Impression Recruitment for a confidential conversation about the opportunity.

title: Supporter Engagement Assistant
description:
Supporter Engagement Assistant

Harrogate, Noth Yorkshire

Please note, this role is on-site initially with flexibility to work from home on non-team days as per work/team requirements.

About Us

Yorkshire is one of the regions hardest hit by cancer. Together, we can change this.

Yorkshire Cancer Research is a charity dedicated to funding research so that you and those you love live longer healthier lives, free of cancer.

Thanks to supporters, the charity funds vital cancer research and pioneers innovative new services for people with cancer. These life-giving medical breakthroughs are helping more people survive cancer - in Yorkshire, and beyond.

As an inclusive employer, our aim is to ensure our workforce reflects the rich diversity of our region. We believe a diverse workforce is vital to us taking action to prevent, diagnose and treat cancer more effectively in Yorkshire. We offer equal opportunities regardless of race, religion or belief, age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, marriage and civil partnerships.

We've got a strong set of values that inform everything we do, and we're looking for people who are aligned with these. As a Supporter Engagement Assistant, you will put people in Yorkshire at the heart of everything you do, unite with colleagues and other organisations in this cause, and dare to think big and bold to make positive solutions happen.

To find out more about our values and how important they are to us, please read the role profile linked above.

The Benefits

We offer a wide and generous range of benefits designed to support our employees through every stage of life. To read about these, please see the benefits section of our Careers Page.

The Role

Reporting to the Supporter Engagement Manager, as Supporter Engagement Assistant, you will deliver excellent customer service over the telephone, in written (email and postal) communications and face to face and ensure that supporters' details are accurately recorded on the CRM database. You will be representing the charity, explaining its purpose, and demonstrating our charity values to donors/supporters, showing appropriate empathy to those who may have cancer or a family member/friend who does.

From supporters who are interested in making a one off donation or a regular gift to supporters enquiring about the work the charity funds and everything in between, the Supporter Engagement Assistant will ensure every donor is valued and receives an exceptional customer experience and on-going stewardship.

This role provides a great opportunity to make a real difference to the people of Yorkshire and requires someone with a friendly manner, good team-working skills, great customer service and excellent organisational skills.

Specifically, you will:
- Ensure supporter communications are accurate, timely and appropriate to the recipient. This includes following the relevant pathways to process donations, record legacy pledges, update key information so that the communication is tailored and relevant to the individual supporter.
- Work alongside the Supporter Engagement Team and other colleagues to improve the initial welcome journey for newly acquired donors and the onward stewardship of all supporters.
- Conduct research and contribute ideas to improve supporter journeys and implement these processes independently.
- Update supporter records on the charity's CRM database to reflect changes in marketing permissions, personal details, the charity's relationship with the supporter (e.g. Volunteer/ Donor etc) and any communications between the supporter and the charity.
- Use the CRM database to run supplied data queries to deliver campaigns (e.g. using Mail Merge) and to create and deliver supporter communications, this includes printing and posting letters, sending emails, making updates to supporter records and fulfilling requests for information.
- Undertake other duties and take on a lead role in delivering projects and campaigns relevant to the purpose of the role as requested by members of the CRM, Marketing, Fundraising or Research & Services teams.
- Monitor inbound emails and telephone calls to the charity, forwarding to the relevant colleague (if unable to provide a response) or responding and actioning.

About You

To be considered for this role, you will need:
- To be ideally educated to A-Level or equivalent level.
- To have customer service experience in a similar or related role (e.g. telephony/ databases/ office).
- To have high computer literacy with comprehensive knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, especially Word, Excel and Outlook.
- To have previous experience of working with databases (e.g. Access or Raiser's Edge).
- To be up to date with the requirements of GDPR and confident in adhering to these requirements.
- To be up to date with Safeguarding and confident in raising any concerns.
- To be someone that enjoys delivering excellent customer service and customer/supporter interaction.
- To be happy to work independently and ask for support where this is needed, but also like to both work with and support colleagues as part of a team working towards a common goal.
- To have excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with an ability to use active listening skills, and write professionally and appropriately for a range of diverse audiences. Has a good grasp of grammar, spelling and of the spoken word.
- To have strong organisational skills and performs their work to an extremely high level of accuracy and professionalism, paying close attention to detail.
- To be able to manage multiple workstreams, with the ability to prioritise workloads to meet deadlines.
- To be capable of handling sensitive, challenging conversations with tact and empathy.
- To be willing to remain informed about our work and be a passionate brand ambassador.

Application

Before applying, please read the full role profile.

Yorkshire Cancer Research is a responsible and flexible employer. We welcome any discussion for flexible working at the interview/offer stage where we will consider an individual's circumstances against the needs of the charity.

We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates from all backgrounds. If we can make any reasonable adjustments to support your application please contact us.
